title: JigsawStructure Misc
description: A Jigsaw Structure is a group of Structure Templates that make up a larger structure. Jigsaw Structures are placed during world generation.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

biome_filters.title: Biome Filters
biome_filters.description:
Biomes in which the Jigsaw Structure can generate.

Properties:
• domain (object)
• operator (object)
• subject (object)
• test (string)
• value (object)

description.title: Description
description.description:
Identifier of the Jigsaw Structure.

Properties:
• identifier (object)

dimension_padding.title: Dimension Padding
dimension_padding.description: Dimension padding prevents the structure from getting cut off at the top or bottom of the world.

heightmap_projection.title: HeightmapProjection
heightmap_projection.description: Heightmap used to calculate the relative start height. For example, a heightmap_projection of ocean_floor and a start_height of 10 means the Jigsaw Structure will begin generating 10 blocks above the ocean floor. Defaults to 'none'

liquid_settings.title: LiquidSettings
liquid_settings.description: How to handle waterloggable blocks overlapping with existing liquid.

max_depth.title: Max Depth
max_depth.description: The maximum recursion depth for Jigsaw Structure Generation. For example, a Jigsaw Structure that builds a road with a max_depth of 5 will only have paths that are a maximum of 5 structures templates in length in any given direction from the origin.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: The max distance on the horizontal plane (XZ): [1-128]

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: The max distance on the vertical axis (Y). Defaults to no limit.

defaultSnippets.label: Max Distance From Center (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Max Distance From Center as an object

max_distance_from_center.title: Max Distance From Center
max_distance_from_center.description: The max distances on the horizontal plane and optionally the vertical axis from the jigsaw pieces to the structure start.

defaultSnippets.label: Max Distance From Center (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Max Distance From Center as an object

pool_aliases.title: Pool Aliases
pool_aliases.description: Pool Aliases are used to determine which template pool can be a substitute.

start_height.title: Start Height
start_height.description: Height at which the Jigsaw Structure's start pool should begin.

start_jigsaw_name.title: Start Jigsaw Name
start_jigsaw_name.description: The start jigsaw name is the name of the jigsaw block from the start pool to be placed first.

start_pool.title: Start Pool
start_pool.description: The first Template Pool to use when generating the Jigsaw Structure.

step.title: GenerationStep
step.description: Species the world generation phase in which the structure is generated.

terrain_adaptation.title: TerrainAdaptation
terrain_adaptation.description: How the terrain should adapt relative to the generated Jigsaw Structure.
